title: Happily Ever After | KEY.co
description_expanded: Ascend to the third floor, where privacy and elegance converge. The master suite is a haven of sophistication, complete with balcony access for soaking in the panoramic views, a cozy seating area for intimate conversations, and a flat-screen TV for leisurely entertainment. A walk-in closet and an opulent en suite bathroom add to the grandeur. The additional bedrooms offer plush queen beds and share a well-appointed hall bathroom. Outside, the sunny patio with a grill calls for family barbecues under the azure sky. The home also includes the leisurely luxury of a six-seater golf cart, ensuring every nearby attraction is within easy reach, from the zero-entry community pool to vibrant on-site restaurants and shopping experiences, punctuating your stay with convenience and charm. Escape to the warmth and tranquility of a stunning beach house where the sun-kissed shores beckon for unforgettable moments. With its expansive three-story layout, this Florida gem offers four elegantly appointed bedrooms, and three-and-a-half-bathrooms, and comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests. Ideal for large families or a gathering of friends, the home's chic yet shabby elegance provides a sophisticated backdrop for creating cherished memories. Each floor unveils a new layer of luxury, from the delightful bunk room on the first floor to the serenity of private bedrooms on the top tier, promising comfort and joy for every member of your party.
